item.title: Apex Legends x Gundam Event Announced
item.description: The crossover event has a date of March 10th and a trailer.

item.title: Homura Hime, an anime-style 3D action game, in the works for Nintendo Switch 2
item.description: According to Playism and Crimson Dusk, Nintendo Switch 2 is getting Homura Hime. The title will be available later this year. Homura Hime is an anime-style 3D action game that combines exhilarating thrills with the tension-filled gameplay of bullet hell. Expect to dodge projectiles, unleash combos, and take advantage of dodges and parries to withstand demonic enemies.

item.title: The Division 2 Year 8 Kicks Off in April; Crossplay, New Content and DLC Announced
item.description: The Division 2 Year 8 kicks off in April, and it will bring a slew of new content including crossplay. New premium DLC confirmed for 2026.

item.title: Triangle Strategy PS5 physical edition launches May 29 in Southeast Asia
item.description: Square Enix will release a physical edition of Triangle Strategy for PlayStation 5 on May 29 in Southeast Asia, the company announced. It will support both English and Japanese voice-overs and subtitles.

item.title: PlayStation and Xbox veteran launches indie-focused talent agency
item.description: The nascent agency intends to help Indies and small studios by 'delivering Fortune 500 recruiting expertise without the cost of a full-time hire.'

item.title: Trump administration debates allowing Tencent to keep its gaming stakes, FT reports
item.description: Top officials have held internal meetings to assess whether Tencent's investments in U.S. and Finnish gaming firms pose a national security risk, the newspaper said, citing several people familiar with the deliberations.

item.title: Introducing The Sims Maker Program and The Sims 4 Marketplace
item.description: A new in-game platform designed to support custom content creators and help more players discover their work.

item.title: Resurrection of the Insomnia Gaming Festival cancelled due to lack of industry support
item.description: Organisers call off attempt to revive UK LAN event; ticket-holders to receive refunds

item.title: Battlefield 6 Faces Player Outrage After Turning $50 Skins Free in Just One Week
item.description: Battlefield 6 is causing frustration among some of its fans after giving away skins that many players had previously paid 50 euros for.

item.title: Scott Pilgrim EX Review The Gamer's Lounge
item.description: Scott Pilgrim is back with a bang. The sequel to 2010 vs The World is here. There are not enough good things I can say about this game or the series in general. If you are a fan of brawlers, or enjoyed the first game, EX is well worth playing.
